summary: Backend + frontend testing for the new Pencairan Dana (Campus Disbursements) feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_campus_disbursements.py — 19/19 pytest tests pass. Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_beneficiary_pm.py still 30/30 green. UI verified via preview URL for Admin Provinsi (menu-pencairan-dana → disbursement-manager → 12 campus rows, 12 recipients, campus detail modal with 12 stage cards, audit button, search + region filter + upload proof button, 0px mobile overflow at 390px) and for a temporary admin_wilayah Jakarta Barat (read-only: disbursement-regional-scope indicator visible, upload button hidden, region filter hidden, review queue hidden, save-campus-stage button hidden, sees only 2 Jakarta Barat campuses). Old 'Kelola Data PM' label is gone from sidebar and dashboard title; only 'Pencairan Dana' shows. Found & fixed one backend bug (MongoDB $set/$setOnInsert operator conflict in ensure_campus_disbursement) that was making every aggregate-update request return 500.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED HERE: ensure_campus_disbursement (server.py:1436) originally listed recipient_user_ids in BOTH the $setOnInsert defaults and the $set update payload, causing MongoDB to raise 'Updating the path recipient_user_ids would create a conflict' and every PUT /api/admin/disbursements/campuses/*/regions/*/stages/* returned 500. Removed recipient_user_ids from the $setOnInsert defaults so only $set writes it. Please re-review the fix during merge.

attach_transfer_to_campus_disbursement (server.py:1666) calls ensure_campus_disbursement then immediately does a second update with $addToSet on the same recipient_user_ids — after the fix this is still correct because ensure_* is now the sole writer of the field via $set. Verified via the existing transfer proof upload flow validation tests still pass.

combine_campus_stage sums float(amount or 0) then does `or None` which returns None when total is exactly 0 — intentional for empty groups but may hide legitimate zero-amount aggregates. Not blocking.

campus_disbursement_audit reads collection beneficiary_audit_events with detail.campus_key filter but there is no dedicated audit collection index on that field; will full-scan once the audit trail grows. Consider adding an index on beneficiary_audit_events(detail.campus_key, created_at).

profile_region() still falls back to profile.data.provinsi when kota is empty (carried over from iter 19/20) — students whose profile has kota blank but provinsi='DKI Jakarta' will surface as region 'DKI Jakarta' and never fall inside any of the six DKI regional admin scopes.

DisbursementManager filters campuses client-side with campus name containsFilter — for the /admin/disbursements/campuses endpoint the search query parameter is already applied server-side; the client re-filter is redundant but harmless.

rca of the issue: Symptom: PUT /api/admin/disbursements/campuses/{key}/regions/{region}/stages/{stage} returned HTTP 500 with backend log 'pymongo.errors.WriteError: Updating the path recipient_user_ids would create a conflict at recipient_user_ids'. Root cause: ensure_campus_disbursement built its $setOnInsert defaults dict with recipient_user_ids inside it, and also sent recipient_user_ids in the $set clause of the same update_one() call. MongoDB rejects any update where two operators target the same path. Reproduction: authenticate as admin/super_admin, call PUT on any campus+region+stage combo (works for both existing and new aggregate records). Fix: remove recipient_user_ids from defaults so $setOnInsert only inserts the constant seed columns and $set remains the sole writer of recipient_user_ids on every call. Verified all 19 new tests + 30 existing PM tests pass afterwards.
